title: Mode 2: Test harness (P/F/O/S/B/ST/SEC suites)
description:
Implement Mode 2 test harness from docs/plans/15-mode2-e2e-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P5: session lifecycle FSM, event normalization consistency, config path stability, idle snapshot trigger invariant, attach/detach safety
- Fault injection F1-F5: PTY timeout/hung child, event-source partial failure (disable OTEL/hooks/log), credential injection failure, pause/resume race under burst, driver crash mid-turn
- Oracle O1-O3: source-fusion vs ground-truth, Claude vs Codex parity, Mode 1/Native reference
- Simulations S1-S3: session-log replay, lifecycle command simulation, config-dir migration
- Benchmarks B1-B4: normalization p95<200ms, PTY throughput, attach p95<150ms, idle snapshot trigger p95<500ms
- Stress ST1-ST3: 12h driver soak, multi-session stress, burst lifecycle stress
- Security SEC1-SEC4: credential isolation, config-dir perms, session-log sanitization, PTY input hardening
- CI tier mapping: PR-fast ~20s, PR-standard ~60s, Nightly ~3h

Depends on: Mode 2 E2E core task.
